## Pre-Merge Checklist

- [ ] **Contracts updated**: All shapes and DTOs originate from `packages/contracts`.
- [ ] **Migration reviewed**: Any SQL migration generated by Drizzle has been inspected and tested locally.
- [ ] **Tests added**: Unit tests co-located and API integration tests added for every new endpoint.
- [ ] **Permissions declared**: All routes have explicit `@Can(...)` decorators (deny by default).
- [ ] **Tenant scope applied**: Repositories filter strictly by `schemeIds` and `stateIds`.
- [ ] **No secrets**: Verified no credentials, tokens, or unmasked PII are committed.
- [ ] **Documentation / ADR**: Architecture Decision Records in `docs/adr/` updated if architectural design changed.
- [ ] **Clean CI**: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` pass locally.
